title: 2021: Year of the Linux Gaming Desktop - Andrew Kelley
summary: Andrew Kelley's Zig SHOWTIME talk on an experiment to ship static Linux executables that can do graphics and gaming, followed by an interview. It covers the problems of Linux binary stability, dynamic linking and the graphics ABI.
why: HN cites it in threads on Linux desktop application distribution as a clear treatment of why binary compatibility and static linking are hard.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages
